headlines.hero: Confiez votre projet immobilier à une experte locale

agent_info.name: Clotilde Martin
agent_info.quote: VENDRE ou ACHETER un bien immobilier est un acte important et l'accompagnement d'un professionnel est nécessaire pour réussir votre projet sereinement et en toute sécurité.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Playfair Display' for all Headings to give a premium/trust feel. Import it from Google Fonts.
Ensure the Primary Blue (#0079e8) is used for all primary actions (Buttons, Links, Active States).
The Form must be the focal point of the page. Consider placing a version of it in the Hero or immediately below.
Use the 'lucide-react' library for icons (Phone, MapPin, Home, Mail).
Implement smooth scrolling for anchor links.
Ensure mobile responsiveness is perfect as traffic comes from Meta Ads.
Use the provided image URLs for the specific sections.
Add a 'data-testid' to the form submit button and inputs.
